description: AGSC-08-32: on a node that declares contexts, the label check of AGSC-05-21 is made inside each context, and inside a context two published items with equal title after NFC and case folding are the warning AGSC-E419 whatever their types, reported on the later one by path. Derivation: the configuration is the fixture's with domain.contexts naming the clusters billing and shipping, each with a namespace; the clusters are added. Four items are titled Account: account-a (concept, billing), account-b (concept, shipping), account-c (concept, billing, written ACCOUNT) and the procedure account-steps (billing). account-a is the first of the billing group by path; account-c is a second concept of that context and account-steps a second item of another type, so each is one AGSC-E419, and neither is AGSC-E416. account-b is in the other context and is compared with nothing: the 1.0 check would have reported it as AGSC-E416 beside account-a, and 1.1 reports no warning for it. Two warnings, exit 0.
